title: Sturdy, modern and easy to assemble.
text: Sturdy, modern and easy to assemble.. Very easy to assemble. All the pcs were there and in perfect condition. Took 30 minutes to put together and the mattress feels AMAZING!!! Not to mention how sleek and modern the headboard is! Great price and well worth it.
